tools.name: publicrecords--sports-odds-api
tools.title: Sports Odds API: BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG
tools.description:
Sports Odds API: BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG. Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call: BetRivers (12 US states + Ontario), Unibet (7 countries), Paf, Svenska Spel and ATG. One row per game with every book's price and the best price per outcome.

When to use: Use when you need current pre-match or live prices for a game or league from Kambi-powered books (BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG) and want to compare books or find the best price per outcome. Not for DraftKings/FanDuel or historical odds.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/sports-odds-api" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/sports-odds-api

leagues.title: Leagues or sports
leagues.description: Kambi paths, sport or league level: "basketball/nba", "american_football/nfl", "ice_hockey/nhl", "baseball/mlb", "football/england/premier_league", or a whole sport such as "tennis". Unknown paths are answered with suggestions and are never charged.

operators.title: Sportsbooks
operators.description: Kambi-powered books to price. Each book is a separate brand/jurisdiction feed; prices can differ between them. The list contains only books verified open on the date in the README.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: "main" returns the headline markets per game. "all" returns each game's full board (often 300–500 markets) and is priced higher. Options: main = Main lines (moneyline, spread, total); all = Every market incl. player props and alternates.

includeLive.title: Include in-play games
includeLive.description: Include games already started (live prices at the moment of the run).

startsWithinHours.title: Only games starting within (hours)
startsWithinHours.description: 0 = no limit. Live games are kept when "Include in-play games" is on.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: On by default. Kambi limits how often one IP may ask; your run moves to a fresh Apify Proxy IP whenever it is slowed down. Turn off only to test without a proxy.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Sports Odds API: BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG

tools.name: scrapemint--sports-odds-scraper
tools.title: Sports Odds Scraper: DraftKings, Pinnacle & Bovada
tools.description:
Sports Odds Scraper: DraftKings, Pinnacle & Bovada. Sports betting odds from DraftKings, Pinnacle and Bovada on one line per game, with the best price per outcome and arbitrage. Moneyline, spread and totals for NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, UFC, college and soccer. American or decimal. Keyless, no login, no browser.

When to use: Use when you need DraftKings, Pinnacle or Bovada moneyline, spread and total lines for US leagues, UFC or soccer, side by side with the best price per outcome.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "scrapemint/sports-odds-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/scrapemint/sports-odds-scraper

sports.title: Sports + leagues
sports.description: Sports/leagues to sweep: nfl, ncaaf, nba, wnba, ncaab, mlb, nhl, ufc, soccer_epl, soccer_laliga, soccer_bundesliga, soccer_seriea, soccer_ligue1, soccer_mls, soccer_uefa_cl, soccer_uefa_el (or short forms like epl, mls, ucl). Any ESPN sport/league path like soccer/bra.1 also works.

eventUrls.title: Event URLs
eventUrls.description: No longer supported (the sportsbook pages these pointed at block automated access). Use sports[] instead; URL entries return a free explanatory row.

books.title: Sportsbooks to include
books.description: No longer used, kept so older saved inputs keep working. Every run reads both available feeds: one bookmaker via ESPN's public scoreboard, typically DraftKings, plus Bovada's own prices. Setting this has no effect on what is returned.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Which betting markets to pull per event.

oddsFormat.title: Odds format
oddsFormat.description: How to express prices in the row. Options: american = American (-110 / +200); decimal = Decimal (1.91 / 3.00); fractional = Fractional (10/11 / 2/1); implied_probability = Implied probability (0.524 / 0.333).

computeBestPrice.title: Compute best price per outcome
computeBestPrice.description: Attach a bestPrice field per outcome with the highest odds and which book offers it, compared across the books that priced that outcome. Events carried by only one book are left alone.

computeArbitrage.title: Compute arbitrage edges
computeArbitrage.description: Flag two way and three way markets where the best prices across books guarantee a profit. Adds an arbitrage object per market when found.

minArbPct.title: Minimum arbitrage edge (%)
minArbPct.description: Drop arbitrage opportunities below this edge. 0.5 means at least 0.5% guaranteed return.

minBestEdgePct.title: Minimum best price edge vs market average (%)
minBestEdgePct.description: Filter best price flags to only those that beat the average price across books by this percent.

totalMaxEvents.title: Total maximum events
totalMaxEvents.description: Hard cap on event rows pushed per run. 0 means unlimited.

maxEventsPerSport.title: Max events per sport
maxEventsPerSport.description: Per league cap. Useful when scraping multiple leagues in one run.

includeStartedEvents.title: Include in play events
includeStartedEvents.description: Include events already in progress. Off keeps the feed to upcoming events only.

lookAheadHours.title: Look ahead window (hours)
lookAheadHours.description: Only return events starting within this many hours from now. 0 means no time limit.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip event IDs already pushed in previous runs (keyed by sport + home + away + commenceTime). Turn off to refresh stale rows.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: No longer used (one request per sport now). Kept for compatibility.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Not used: the odds source works from datacenter IPs without any proxy. Kept for compatibility with older saved inputs.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Sports Odds Scraper: DraftKings, Pinnacle & Bovada

tools.name: zen-studio--prizepicks-player-props
tools.title: PrizePicks Player Props Scraper - Real-Time Lines
tools.description:
PrizePicks Player Props Scraper - Real-Time Lines. Extract real-time player prop lines from PrizePicks across 29 leagues. Get over/under lines, odds tiers, player stats, team matchups, and game schedules. NBA, MLB, NHL, Soccer, Tennis, and esports. Filter by league or player name. 51 fields per prop. JSON, CSV, Excel export.

When to use: Use when the question is about player prop lines (over/under) on PrizePicks for a league, team or player.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "zen-studio/prizepicks-player-props" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/zen-studio/prizepicks-player-props

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: Select one or more leagues to fetch player props for. Choose All to get every available projection across all leagues. Don't see a league (e.g. a seasonal event)? Add it under Other leagues below, or enable List available leagues to see everything live right now. Example: ["MLB","World Cup"]

extraLeagues.title: Other leagues
extraLeagues.description: Type any league name exactly as it appears on PrizePicks (e.g. World Cup ), comma-separated. Use this for seasonal events not in the list above. Combined with your selection above.

listLeagues.title: List available leagues
listLeagues.description: Turn this on to output the leagues currently offering props and how many, then stop. Use it to see exactly what you can request. Ignores all other inputs.

playerNames.title: Player Names
playerNames.description: Comma-separated player names, case-insensitive. Matches partial names and handles accents (Jokic matches Jokić). Example: Jokic, Haaland, Ohtani . Leave empty to get all players.

statTypes.title: Stat Types
statTypes.description: Comma-separated stat types, case-insensitive. Accepts full names or abbreviations. Example: Points, PRA, Rebounds, Goals, SOT . Stat types are league-specific — see README for the full list grouped by sport. Leave empty to get all stats.

oddsTiers.title: Odds Tiers
oddsTiers.description: Filter by line difficulty. Standard is the normal line, Demon is harder with higher payout, Goblin is easier with lower payout. Select one or more. Leave empty to get all tiers.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Comma-separated team names or abbreviations, case-insensitive. Matches player's team or either side of the matchup. Example: Lakers, LAL, Celtics, BOS . Leave empty to get all teams.

feedback.title: Feedback to the maintainers
feedback.description: For AI agents. Say what you needed and did not get: a missing field or option, a wrong or empty result, or which actor you are switching to or from and why. Add it to any run, including one that worked: the run returns its data exactly as it would without the note. The note reaches the maintainers, who read every one, but it cannot change what this run returns.

annotations.title: PrizePicks Player Props Scraper - Real-Time Lines

tools.name: sports-odds-lab--football-odds-results
tools.title: Soccer & Football Betting Odds: Historical & Closing Lines
tools.description:
Soccer & Football Betting Odds: Historical & Closing Lines. Soccer odds, football betting odds and football data API: Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Champions League + 1,000 leagues. Up to 120 bookmakers: 1X2, over/under, BTTS, Asian handicap, opening & closing. Results, xG, shots, corners, scorers. History back to 2005.

When to use: Use for soccer odds history, opening and closing lines, results and match stats (xG, shots, corners) going back to 2005, e.g. backtesting or closing-line value.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "sports-odds-lab/football-odds-results" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/sports-odds-lab/football-odds-results

mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Recent matches: every competition from up to 7 days back to 7 days ahead (upcoming matches with current odds). Full seasons: complete seasons of the leagues you list below, history back to 2005 — add the leagues in the 'Full seasons' section. Options: recent = Recent matches (7 days back to 7 days ahead); seasons = Full seasons (history back to 2005).

statuses.title: Match status
statuses.description: Finished includes matches decided after extra time or penalties and awarded results. In 'Full seasons' mode only finished (and postponed/cancelled) matches exist.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many past days to include (0 = today only). Up to 7. Values above 7 are clamped to 7.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: How many upcoming days to include. Up to 7. Upcoming matches carry the current prices instead of closing lines. Values above 7 are clamped to 7.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Optional. Country or region names as shown on Flashscore, e.g. England, Spain, Brazil, Europe (UEFA club and national-team competitions), World (friendlies, FIFA). Leave empty for every country.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.description: Optional. 'Country: Competition' as shown on Flashscore, e.g. 'England: Premier League', 'Spain: LaLiga', 'Europe: Champions League'. Stages are included automatically ('Argentina: Liga Profesional' also matches its Apertura and Clausura). A name without a country (e.g. 'Premier League') matches that name in every country. Example: ["England: Premier League","Spain: LaLiga","Italy: Serie A","Germany: Bundesliga","France: Ligue 1","Europe: Champions League"]

includeWomen.title: Include women's football
includeWomen.description: Women's leagues, cups and national-team matches.

includeYouth.title: Include youth and reserve teams
includeYouth.description: U17–U23, reserve, B-team and academy competitions.

incremental.title: Only new or changed matches (for schedules)
incremental.description: For runs every few minutes: skip finished, live and cancelled matches whose score and status have not changed since an earlier run with the same settings, and upcoming matches whose prices, lines and kick-off have not moved — faster, and you pay only for new data. The memory lives in a key-value store 'football-odds-incremental' in your account.

incrementalName.title: Incremental memory name
incrementalName.description: Optional name for the incremental memory, to keep several schedules apart or start fresh (a new name = a new memory). Empty = one memory per combination of settings.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: 'Country: League' as shown on Flashscore — e.g. 'England: Premier League', 'Spain: LaLiga', 'Germany: Bundesliga', 'Brazil: Serie A', 'Europe: Champions League' — or the league's Flashscore URL. Every stage of a season is included (play-offs, championship and relegation groups). Example: ["England: Premier League"]

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.description: Optional. Seasons as the league names them: 2024-2025 for autumn–spring leagues, 2024 for calendar-year leagues (MLS, Brazil, Scandinavia). Leave empty to use 'Last seasons'. Example: ["2024-2025"]

lastSeasons.title: Last seasons
lastSeasons.description: Used when Seasons is empty: the current season (matches played so far) plus this many minus one previous seasons. 5 = the current season and the four before it; 22 = the whole history since 2005/06 in one run.

markets.title: Betting markets
markets.description: Full-time markets to collect. 1X2 is always included — it shows which bookmakers priced the match.

overUnderLines.title: Over/Under lines
overUnderLines.description: Goal lines to return, e.g. 1.5, 2.5, 3.5. Enter 'all' for every line each bookmaker offers (0.5 to 6.5, quarter lines included).

asianHandicapLines.title: Asian handicap lines
asianHandicapLines.description: The main line is the one whose consensus is closest to 50/50 (reported as ahLine; the opening main line as ahLineOpening). Options: main = Main line only; all = All lines.

bookmakers.title: Only these bookmakers
bookmakers.description: Optional. Names or parts of names, e.g. bet365, Betano, SNAI, Winamax. Leave empty for every bookmaker in scope (about 30 listings, or up to about 120 with 'All bookmakers').

allBookmakers.title: All bookmakers (up to ~120)
allBookmakers.description: Read the odds menus of ~55 countries instead of 10: up to about 120 bookmaker listings for a top-league match (default about 30) — Italian (SNAI, Sisal, Eurobet), French (Winamax, PMU, Unibet), Romanian, Czech, Greek, Latin American, African and Asian books. History gains too (Premier League 2024/25: 69 instead of 20 per match). Same price per match; runs take about 2–3× longer.

includeOdds.title: Include odds
includeOdds.description: Opening and latest (closing) odds per bookmaker plus the no-vig consensus.

onlyWithOdds.title: Skip matches without odds
onlyWithOdds.description: Do not save (and do not pay for) matches that no bookmaker priced. About 1 in 5 matches, mostly amateur and youth football.

includeStats.title: Include match statistics
includeStats.description: xG, xGOT, xA, possession, shots, big chances, corners, passes, fouls, cards and more for finished and live matches (full detail for major competitions).

includeEvents.title: Include goals and cards
includeEvents.description: Every goal with minute, scorer, assist and score after the goal; penalties (scored and missed), own goals, yellow and red cards.

maxMatches.title: Max matches
maxMatches.description: Stop after saving this many matches (0 = no limit). A busy weekend day has 1,500+ matches; a full season of a top league 300–400.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: Advanced. Requests in parallel (1–192). The default 128 is about six times faster than 16, with the same odds coverage.

annotations.title: Soccer & Football Betting Odds: Historical & Closing Lines

tools.name: hgservices--apify-actor-espn
tools.title: ESPN Sports Scores & Schedules - NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, EPL..
tools.description:
ESPN Sports Scores & Schedules - NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, EPL... Get live scores, schedules, and game results from ESPN — covering NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, EPL, NCAA, and more. Find the next game of any team. No API key needed. Filter by team, date, or status. Empty results explain why.

When to use: Use when you need scores, schedules or final results for NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, EPL, NCAA and other leagues, or a team's next game.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "hgservices/apify-actor-espn" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/hgservices/apify-actor-espn

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: League codes: nba, wnba, ncaam (NCAA men's basketball), ncaaw (NCAA women's basketball), nfl, ncaaf (NCAA football), mlb, nhl, mls, epl (English Premier League), laliga, ucl (UEFA Champions League). Ask only for the leagues you need: each league costs one request per day.

dateMode.title: Date Mode
dateMode.description: nextGames: the next games that are not over, from today - per league the next game day, or with 'teams' the next game of each team. Use it for 'when do they play next'. Many leagues skip days (NFL: mostly Thu, Sun, Mon), so 'today' is often empty. today, tomorrow, yesterday: one day. thisWeek: Mon-Sun. thisWeekend: Sat-Sun. next7Days, last7Days: 7 days from or to today. single: 'date'. range: 'startDate' to 'endDate', up to 366 days. Days are in 'timezone'. Options: today = Today; tomorrow = To…

date.title: Date
date.description: Date for 'single' date mode, as YYYYMMDD (or YYYY-MM-DD).

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: First day for 'range' date mode, as YYYYMMDD (or YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Last day for 'range' date mode, as YYYYMMDD (or YYYY-MM-DD). A range can be up to 366 days. A longer range is cut to 366 days, and the run reports this in a notice item.

teams.title: Team Filter
teams.description: Only return games of these teams. Use an ESPN code (LAL, GS, NY, WSH), a common code (GSW, NYK, WAS, LAK) or a team name (Lakers, Golden State Warriors). An entry applies to every selected league. To limit it to one league, add a league prefix, for example nba:LAC. Entries that match no team are reported in a notice item. Leave empty for all teams.

homeAwayFilter.title: Home/Away Filter
homeAwayFilter.description: Only with teams: all games of those teams, only their home games, or only their away games. With dateMode nextGames, it finds the next home (or away) game. Options: all = All Games; home = Home Games Only; away = Away Games Only.

gameStatus.title: Game Status Filter
gameStatus.description: pre = scheduled (not started), in = in progress, post = final (also postponed or canceled). Keep all three unless you need only one kind, for example ["post"] for results only.

liveOnly.title: Live Games Only
liveOnly.description: Only games in progress at the moment of the run. Often empty: most games are in the evening (US time). For a schedule or scores, leave it false and read status.state of each game.

startingWithinHours.title: Starting Within Hours
startingWithinHours.description: Only scheduled games that start in the next N hours (1-72). Games in progress and final games are kept.

nationalTvOnly.title: National TV Only
nationalTvOnly.description: Only games on a US national TV or streaming network (ESPN, ABC, TNT, FOX, NBC, CBS, Prime Video and others).

networkFilter.title: Network Filter
networkFilter.description: Only games on these networks, as ESPN names them (for example ESPN, TNT, ABC, Prime Video). Not case-sensitive.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone (for example America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London). It sets what today, tomorrow and the other relative modes mean, and the time in dateLocal. Use the user's timezone.

includeNotices.title: Explain empty or changed results
includeNotices.description: When a run returns no games, or the Actor ignored or changed part of the input, write one item with type 'notice' at the start of the dataset. It says why (for example: no NFL games today, the next ones are on Thursday) and what to change. Game items have type 'game'. Turn this off if your pipeline must get game items only. The explanation is also in the run's status message and in the SUMMARY record.

tools.name: constructive_calm--understat-football-analytics
tools.title: Understat xG & Shot Data - Football Analytics
tools.description:
Understat xG & Shot Data - Football Analytics. Scrapes Understat: player/team season aggregates, per-match xG/PPDA/win-probabilities, shot-level data with x/y coords + xG, situation/formation/game-state breakdowns, player career histories, and fixtures across the Big 5 + RFPL (2014–2025). Multi-season + multi-league in a single run.

When to use: Use for expected goals (xG), shot maps, PPDA and player or team season stats in the Big 5 European leagues and RFPL.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "constructive_calm/understat-football-analytics" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/constructive_calm/understat-football-analytics

mode.title: Scraping mode
mode.description: What to scrape. 'league_players' returns per-player season aggregates (xG, xA, xGChain, xGBuildup, etc). 'league_teams' returns team season aggregates (W/D/L, xG, xGA, PPDA, points, xPoints). 'league_matches' returns played-match metadata (xG, win-prob, deep, ppda). 'match_shots' returns every shot with x/y coords, xG, situation, body part, result. 'team_situations' returns long-format breakdowns by situation/formation/game-state/timing/zones. 'player_career' returns one player's full multi-sea…

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: One or more of the six leagues Understat covers. Required for league_*, match_shots (when matchIds is empty), team_situations (when teams is empty), and fixtures.

seasons.title: Seasons (start year)
seasons.description: List of season start years as integers — 2025 = the 2025/26 season. Understat history goes back to 2014. The current season becomes valid automatically once it kicks off in August. Invalid entries are reported in a status row instead of being dropped silently.

teams.title: Teams (titles)
teams.description: Filter output to specific teams. Applies to league_players, league_teams, league_matches, fixtures, match_shots (league discovery) and team_situations. Names must match Understat's display names — e.g. 'Arsenal', 'Manchester United', 'Real Madrid' (matching is case-insensitive). A name that matches nothing produces a 'team_not_matched' status row with closest-name suggestions instead of failing silently.

matchIds.title: Match IDs (skip enumeration)
matchIds.description: Specific match IDs to scrape directly (used by match_shots). When set, leagues/seasons are ignored. Find IDs in Understat URLs: /match/{ID}.

playerIds.title: Player IDs
playerIds.description: Player IDs for player_career mode. Find IDs in Understat URLs: /player/{ID}. Examples: 553 (Messi), 619 (Agüero), 1250 (Salah), 8260 (Haaland).

positions.title: Positions filter
positions.description: Filter players by position. Only applies to league_players mode (uses Understat's filtered POST endpoint).

nLastMatches.title: Last N matches
nLastMatches.description: Filter player stats to the last N matches. 0 = full season. Only applies to league_players mode.

dateStart.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateStart.description: Restrict league_players stats to matches on or after this date. Leave empty for none.

dateEnd.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateEnd.description: Restrict league_players stats to matches on or before this date. Leave empty for none.

minAppearances.title: Minimum appearances
minAppearances.description: Drop player rows where games played is below this threshold (client-side filter). 0 = no filter.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop emitting after this many dataset rows. 0 = unlimited (subject to maxCostUsd).

maxCostUsd.title: Max cost (USD per run)
maxCostUsd.description: Hard cap on the run's total billed amount. The actor estimates cost up-front and stops gracefully if the cap is hit mid-run.

includeRawJson.title: Include raw Understat JSON
includeRawJson.description: When true, attach the original Understat record under `_raw` on every output row. Useful for power users / debugging. Default off — keeps the dataset light.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Understat does not block scrapers, but residential proxies help users behind corporate networks. Default = Apify residential.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Understat xG & Shot Data - Football Analytics

tools.name: jungle_synthesizer--equibase-us-horse-racing-scraper

tools.description:
Equibase Horse Racing Scraper - US Race Entries & Results. Scrape US Thoroughbred horse racing data from Equibase.com — the official source for North American racing. Extract race entries (horses, jockeys, trainers, odds) and results (finish order, times, payouts) for any date and track. Ideal for handicappers and sports analytics.

When to use: Use for US Thoroughbred race entries and results (horses, jockeys, trainers, morning-line odds, finish order, payouts) for a date and track.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "jungle_synthesizer/equibase-us-horse-racing-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/jungle_synthesizer/equibase-us-horse-racing-scraper

sp_intended_usage.title: What is the intended usage of this data?
sp_intended_usage.description: What will this data feed? E.g. lead lists, KYB checks, price tracking.

sp_improvement_suggestions.title: How can we improve this crawler for you?
sp_improvement_suggestions.description: Provide any feedback or suggestions for improvements.

sp_contact.title: Contact email (optional)
sp_contact.description: We'll personally help with your use case. No spam. Example: "Share your email here..."

raceDate.title: Race Date
raceDate.description: Date to scrape in MM/DD/YYYY format. Defaults to today. Use a recent past date to get completed results. Example: ""

trackCodes.title: Track Codes
trackCodes.description: Optional list of track codes to filter (e.g. AQU, CD, SA, GP). Leave empty to scrape all tracks running on the selected date. Example: []

dataMode.title: Data Mode
dataMode.description: entries = race cards (horses, jockeys, trainers, odds); results = finish order + payouts; both = entries and results together (results only available for past races); late_changes = today's race-day changes instead of race cards, one record per change (scratches, course/surface switches, jockey and weight changes, track conditions; Equibase publishes the current race day only, so leave Race Date empty or set it to today). Options: entries = Entries only; results = Results only; both = Entries +…

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return (each race = one record; in late_changes mode each change = one record). Default 50 samples several meetings; raise it (e.g. 500+) to collect EVERY track racing on the date — the actor enumerates the full daily slate and fills up to this cap.

raceTypes.title: Race types
raceTypes.description: Optional race-type filter, matched as case-insensitive text against each race's type. Example: claiming keeps Claiming, Maiden Claiming, Optional Claiming and Starter Optional Claiming races; maiden keeps every Maiden race. Leave empty for all race types. Not used in late_changes mode. Example: []

filliesMaresOnly.title: Fillies and mares only
filliesMaresOnly.description: Keep only races where every runner is a filly or mare. Off by default. Not used in late_changes mode.

includeHorseHistory.title: Include horse history
includeHorseHistory.description: Adds one extra record per distinct horse in the saved races: every career start (track, date, race, finish, speed figure, race_id that joins to this actor's own race records) and the last 60 days of workouts, read from Equibase's public horse profile. Each profile is fetched once per run and billed as a premium record (see pricing). Not used in late_changes mode. Off by default.

maxHorseProfiles.title: Max horse profiles
maxHorseProfiles.description: Upper bound on horse-history records per run (only used when Include horse history is on). Horses are taken in card order.

annotations.title: Equibase Horse Racing Scraper - US Race Entries & Results

tools.name: congism--polymarket-kalshi-arb-finder
tools.title: Polymarket + Kalshi Arbitrage Finder
tools.description:
Polymarket + Kalshi Arbitrage Finder. Scans both Polymarket and Kalshi for matching binary prediction markets and identifies price discrepancies where buying YES on one platform and NO on the other guarantees a risk-free profit. Returns ranked opportunities with trade details and return %. Now covers PredictIt too - see our Arb Scanner.

When to use: Use when looking for price gaps between matching Polymarket and Kalshi binary markets.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "congism/polymarket-kalshi-arb-finder" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/congism/polymarket-kalshi-arb-finder

minSpread.title: Minimum Price Spread
minSpread.description: Minimum YES price difference between platforms to flag as an arb opportunity (0–1 scale). Example: 0.05 means at least 5 cents difference. Default: 0.02.

minReturnPct.title: Minimum Return % per Trade
minReturnPct.description: Minimum estimated profit % per dollar risked. Example: 1.0 = only show opportunities worth at least 1% return. Default: 0.5.

minSimilarity.title: Minimum Market Match Similarity
minSimilarity.description: Keyword similarity threshold (0–1) for matching markets across platforms. Higher = stricter matching, fewer but more accurate pairs. Default: 0.25.

minLiquidity.title: Minimum Liquidity (USDC / USD)
minLiquidity.description: Only include markets with at least this much liquidity. Filters out thin markets where you can't fill a meaningful position. Default: 0.

minVolume24h.title: Minimum 24h Volume
minVolume24h.description: Only include markets with at least this much 24-hour trading volume. Default: 0.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of arb opportunities to return, sorted by return % descending. Default: 500.

kalshiEmail.title: Kalshi Account Email
kalshiEmail.description: Your Kalshi account email. Required to fetch Kalshi market prices. Without this, only Polymarket data is scanned.

kalshiPassword.title: Kalshi Account Password
kalshiPassword.description: Your Kalshi account password. Stored securely and only used to authenticate with the Kalshi API.
